The department of workforce 3 development shall establish an online, interactive platform 4 that provides and enhances connections between students and 5 professionals to allow students to virtually explore career 6 options from the classroom. The department shall establish 7 a process for schools to enter into a contract with the 8 department to participate in the platform.
